drawn_on: ticket_id, so all five language renderings share a split

age_limit.why: Eligibility states: resident of Sri Lanka over 18 years of age.

card_payment_not_recognised.why: Dispute policy covers unauthorised transactions and the resolution procedure.

card_swallowed.why: Card Centre contact and card blocking/replacement procedure applies.

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.why: Same unauthorised-transaction dispute path as card payments.

compromised_card.why: Dispute policy covers unauthorised use and liability; CBSL page covers not sharing PINs/OTPs and reporting suspicious activity.

lost_or_stolen_card.why: Dispute policy: cardholder must immediately call the Card Centre, agent blocks the card, replacement dispatched within 5 working days.

transfer_fee_charged.why: Card-to-card page states a Rs 100 transaction fee for CRM cash deposits.

caveats: Labels are authored from the corpus text, not human-verified; spot-check before quoting recall as ground truth.
Thresholds are explored on dev only. Holdout is scored once and reported.
The five language arms are translations of one ticket set, so language comparisons must use paired statistics.
